method: Original ROM MIPS audio sequencer executed with Unicorn. Original N64 ADPCM samples and predictor books, source pitch/duration/volume ramps/pan preserved. Dry offline PCM rendering uses linear resampling/equal-power pan; original RSP interpolation/filter and room reverb are not emulated. Not a bit-exact emulator capture. No synthesized replacement sounds.

charge_sustain_verification.source_initializer: 0x801EC5B4 allocates3 actors;0x801EE4AC zeroes their counters;actor+61 indices0/1/2
charge_sustain_verification.method: Original effect handler executed up to render work; only model scale helper and sound API hooked. All cadence/state/actor branches original.
charge_sustain_verification.conclusion: While charge state1or2, every actor calls24D at effect ticks30/90/etc and24E at60/120/etc. Release states0or3 suppress cues. Effect spawned at held tick15: first periodiccue is ~heldtick45(1.5s), then every1s. Three same-ID calls are simultaneous.

charged_coin_contact_verification.method:
Original charged-projectile contact update plus independent victim callback.
Only world geometry query and visual burst allocation are fixtures; receipt tests,
state transitions and positional sound API arguments execute original instructions.
charged_coin_contact_verification.conclusion: Charged coin emits event29A on enemy receipt, additional to victim24F. Without enemy receipt, query result7FFF also emits29A, other query results do not. Lifetime expiry is silent; world-query semantics not inferred.

attack_voice_charge_verification.source: Original USA ROM MIPS executed; only random-index choice, source sound API, and unrelated projectile allocator stubbed. No voice-group lookup, attack initializer, charge logic, or sound table stubbed.
attack_voice_charge_verification.charge_release_dispatch: 0x801E479C..0x801E47EC: charge state3 and >=3 coins -> action7F; action7F 0x801F5024 -> 0x801F50A4 at frame4.5 -> selector12 + random voice group6 + event15A
attack_voice_charge_verification.correction: Earlier handler-prefix proof stubbed the attack collision initializer, unintentionally excluding its voice. Source has first-strike group4, silent second strike, finisher group6 at action entry. Gold Pipe uses the same groups.

gold_pipe_audio_verification.method:
Execute original Goemon Gold Pipe handler audio prefixes, channel evaluation,
bitstream decoder, character sound lookup, and audio calls, with model/frame fixtures.
No audio dispatch or curve decoding is stubbed. Stop after sound dispatch so unrelated
movement/input logic does not need a running level. Recovery handlers execute
fully with animation-length/action-change fixtures. Attack entry collision initialization
is excluded here and covered by verify_attack_voice_charge.py.

shared_entry.excluded: This sound-prefix verification stubs the collision initializer; its entry voices are verified separately by verify_attack_voice_charge.py. It cannot establish voice silence.

gold_pipe_audio_verification.conclusion: Goemon Gold Pipe tier3 uses exactly the same original sound IDs and cue frames as basic pipe; entry voice groups are separately verified by verify_attack_voice_charge.py. Existing pipe_1/2/3 WAVs are already correct.

projectile_contact_verification.method:
Execute original projectile selectors/initializers, then the original victim callback.
External allocation/model/geometry calls are deterministic test fixtures. Attack-class
selection, Task+4C writes, and sound selection execute unmodified ROM instructions.

contact_callback_verification.method: Execute original MIPS contact callback with a victim Task+0x38 collision receipt pointing to an attacker; hook original positional/direct audio APIs. No collision => no sound.
